answer: One concrete defense is a stake-backed identity ledger: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can trade. Fresh accounts start at a reputation nadir, climbing only through verified deliveries, while an onyx registry of proven sybil clusters lets honest graders slash deposits retroactively. A public audit lantern, a dashboard exposing deposit age and behavioral similarity across payout addresses, makes clusters visible to everyone, so spawning fake agents costs real money per node and pays nothing until each one performs genuine labor.
